import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Region – approximate union of Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho
sa = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [11.6,-28.9],[11.6,-17.7],[20.0,-17.7],[29.5,-22.3],[29.5,-28.9],
    [28.0,-30.3],[20.0,-30.3],[11.6,-28.9]
]])

# 2. Helper: sum rainfall for 1 Dec – 31 Jan of given start year
def rainy_window(start_year):
    begin = ee.Date.fromYMD(start_year, 12, 1)
    end   = ee.Date.fromYMD(start_year+1, 2, 1)  # exclusive
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
             .filterDate(begin, end)
             .select('precipitation'))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None
    total = col.sum().rename('total')
    val = (total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                              geometry=sa, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9)
                 .get('total').getInfo())
    px = (total.multiply(0).add(1)  # pixel indicator
            .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                         geometry=sa, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9)
            .get('total').getInfo())
    return val if px > 0 else None

# 3. 2018/19 total
r19 = rainy_window(2018)
if r19 is None:
    print("No 2018/19 data.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. 2000-2018 climatology
clim = []
for y in range(2000, 2019):
    v = rainy_window(y)
    if v is None:
        continue
    clim.append(v)
if not clim:
    print("No climatology data.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

avg = sum(clim)/len(clim)
print(f"2018/19 rainfall: {r19:.1f} mm")
print(f"2000-2018 mean: {avg:.1f} mm")
print(f"Pixels used: {int(px)}")

# 5. Answer
if r19 < avg:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
